items.content: Editorial marketing poster, monsoon season, Indian local-services theme. SCENE: a confident local service professional (electrician/plumber) under soft grey monsoon light, toolbag in hand, warm and approachable, half-frame. SUBJECT: single hero pro, natural skin tones, real texture, shot slightly low for quiet authority. PHONE-UI MOCKUP: a clean smartphone held to the side showing a minimal QckServe listing card — service name, a green 'FREE listing' pill, a 'Call now' button, no clutter. COLOUR SYSTEM: flat blocking only, no gradients — charcoal #1A1A1A background band, QckServe orange #ef6723 / #FF6B00 accent block, warm off-white #FCF9F8 panel, one accent used sparingly. LIGHTING: diffused overcast monsoon key, gentle rim, matte finish, no glossy highlights. TYPE HIERARCHY: one oversized extra-bold condensed caps headline 'MONSOON IS YOUR BUSY SEASON', an italic-serif kicker 'the rush is here', and a giant ₹0 device as the single memorable element. EYE FLOW: top-left logo zone → headline → ₹0 → phone card → qckserve.in bottom-left. CAMERA: 50mm, f/2.8, shallow but legible depth, editorial magazine framing, 4:5. PERFORMANCE LAYER: high thumb-stopping contrast, legible at feed size, benefit readable in under a second.
